procedure.name: wrap-api-call
procedure.step: Identify every API/HTTP client call (fetch, axios, Http, guzzle, requests)
Wrap in try/catch (or try/except for Python)
In catch: log with method name + task description + error data
Show user-facing message with error message only (never internals)
Do NOT rethrow unless explicitly requested

procedure.name: safe-destructure-response
procedure.step: Assign response to a variable (e.g., const res = await axios.get(...))
Only then destructure: const { items } = res.data;

procedure.name: handle-critical-method
procedure.precondition: Method involves financial data or has O(n²+) complexity
procedure.step: On failure: rollback + log full exception (file, line, message) + return error response
Consider Strategy/Observer patterns for severe complexity

procedure.name: permission-denial-pattern
procedure.context: Used in both PHP and Python controllers/views
procedure.step: For undefined exceptions: call default_undefined_exception(request, exception, ClassName::Method)
Both helpers handle logging + redirect + user message internally
